meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步任务拆成可追踪规划文件,上下文丢失后自动恢复。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让 AI 编码代理处理复杂多步任务,且担心中途上下文清空。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI coding agent to keep progress across long multi-step tasks without losing context.

howto.what: Claude 会把任务拆成分步计划,把计划、发现、进度分别写进 task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md。文件存在磁盘上,对话被清空或上下文丢失后也能恢复;做决定前会先读计划,完成一个阶段就更新记录。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 规划、拆解或组织多步骤项目、研究任务,或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发。已有计划文件时,每次对话开始都会先读取。

say.text: 帮我把这个网站重构拆成几步,先建好 task_plan.md 再开工。
say.note: Claude 会先建 task_plan.md,再分步执行。

say.text: 先恢复上一轮会话,读完 findings.md 再继续任务。
say.note: Claude 先读磁盘记录,再接续之前的工作。

howto.what_en: Claude breaks the task into phases and keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss or /clear; it re-reads the plan before decisions and updates records after each phase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or work requiring 5+ tool calls. Existing plan files are read at the start of each conversation.

say_en.text: Break this website refactor into steps; create task_plan.md first, then start.
say_en.note: Claude will create task_plan.md and work step by step.

say_en.text: Log the completed work into progress.md and update task_plan phase status.
say_en.note: Claude syncs progress and phase status to disk.

say_en.text: Restore the previous session, read findings.md, then continue the task.
say_en.note: Claude reads the on-disk records and resumes prior work.
